name: Investment Fund Order Execution
definition: Creation/cancellation of investment units on the books of the fund or its designated agent, as a result of executing an investment fund order.

NonStandardSettlementInformation.name: Non Standard Settlement Information
NonStandardSettlementInformation.definition: Additional specific settlement information for non-regulated traded funds.

DealIdentification.name: Deal Identification
DealIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an order execution, as assigned by a confirming party.

PartiallyExecutedIndicator.name: Partially Executed Indicator
PartiallyExecutedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the order has been partially executed, ie, the confirmed quantity does not match the ordered quantity for a given financial instrument.

InterimProfitAmount.name: Interim Profit Amount
InterimProfitAmount.definition: Part of the price deemed as accrued income or profit rather than capital. The interim profit amount is used for tax purposes.

BestExecution.name: Best Execution
BestExecution.definition: Specifies that the execution was subject to best execution rules as defined by MiFID.

LateReport.name: Late Report
LateReport.definition: Specifies whether the order execution confirmation is late.

SettledIndicator.name: Settled Indicator
SettledIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the cash payment with respect to the executed order is settled.

RegisteredIndicator.name: Registered Indicator
RegisteredIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the executed order has a registered status on the books of the transfer agent.

ExecutedAmount.name: Executed Amount
ExecutedAmount.definition: Amount of money invested or redeemed as a result of an investment fund order.

SourceOfCash.name: Source Of Cash
SourceOfCash.definition: Source of cash used for the settlement of the execution.

UnitsNumber.name: Units Number
UnitsNumber.definition: Number of investment fund units subscribed or redeemed.

ExecutedTradePrice.name: Executed Trade Price
ExecutedTradePrice.definition: Price at which the order was executed.

InformativePrice.name: Informative Price
InformativePrice.definition: Other quoted price than the one at which the order was executed.

CashFlow.name: Cash Flow
CashFlow.definition: Specifies the cash flow resulting from the execution of an order.
